answers.question: Did the agent state the open shift clearly (specialty, time or area)?
answers.quote: I have a wound care shift open on Monday from 7:49 pm to 3:49 am in Jersey City, paying 40 dollars an hour.

answers.question: Was the tone professional, with no pressure or weirdness?
answers.quote: Would you like to take this shift? ... The shift on Monday in Jersey City will be confirmed and you'll receive the schedule and area details by text. Thank you for taking the shift!
